inj.note: Coach Kyle Shanahan stated that Bosa was "a little too optimistic" with his statement that he would be back before the bye, David Lombardi of SFStandard.com reported Friday. The defensive end's chances to play were also diminished because Sunday's game in Atlanta is played on artificial turf. Bosa will continue to recover in anticipation of the 49ers' Week 9 matchup with the Raiders.

news.h: 49ers WR Evans, DE Bosa, WR Samuel out vs. Atlanta; WR Kirk may return
news.d: 49ers receivers Mike Evans and Deebo Samuel Sr., and defensive end Nick Bosa are among a half dozen players who have been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Falcons.

news.h: 49ers rule out Bosa, still hopeful for Evans; Juszczyk will play
news.d: The San Francisco 49ers will have to wait at least another week for the return of defensive end Nick Bosa, though there's at least a chance they'll have both receiver Mike Evans and fullback Kyle Juszczyk for Monday's game vs. the Washington Commanders.
